name: Intermediary 47
definition: Identification of a party and its role.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for an organisation that is allocated by an institution.

LegalEntityIdentifier.name: Legal Entity Identifier
LegalEntityIdentifier.definition: Identification of the party with a Legal Entity Identifier. This is a code allocated to a party as described in ISO 17442 "Financial Services - Legal Entity Identifier (LEI)".

Account.name: Account
Account.definition: Business relationship between two entities; one entity is the account owner, the other entity is the account servicer.
